exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean section
hemoglobin level before a trial of labor after cesarean section
Number of previous trials of labor after cesarean section (0, 1, 2, 3 or more)
classical or low vertical uterine incision
trials of labor after cesarean section
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean section rate
cohort: 1139 women with singleton vertex pregnancies between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation who underwent a trial of labor after one previous cesarean section at a tertiary care center in Saudi Arabia between January 1, 2011, and December 30, 2018.
finding: The rate of vaginal birth after cesarean section increased significantly with an increasing number of previous successful vaginal births after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that the rate of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) increased significantly with the number of previous successful VBAC attempts.
